operations.title: Benincasa corrects the four-site q_G infinity geometry
operations.body: Entry 1167/event 931 makes an important sector correction. Entries 1154-1155 are valid only after an edge-dependent marked residue, which removes one y and yields the P2 del Pezzo/Tate-E7 surface. The physical q_G=sum x_i residue has edge rank zero, leaves four y variables, and gives a P3 quartic double solid. Its smooth benchmark has b3=20, h21=10. The actual source branch is singular at the physical diagonal [1:1:1:1] because Delta=0. Thus the next physical coefficient problem is the local/global nearby-cycle object of this singular quartic double solid, not another marked-node activation test.

authority_basis.summary: Notify Nima of the q_G quartic-double-solid correction.
